001
002package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node;
003
004import java.net.URI;
005
006import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticContext;
007import dev.metaschema.core.model.IDefinition;
008import dev.metaschema.core.model.INamedInstance;
009import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
010
011/**
012 * Represents a node item based on a global definition from a Metaschema.
013 *
014 * @param <D>
015 *          the Java type of the associated Metaschema module definition
016 * @param <I>
017 *          the Java type of the associated Metaschema module instance
018 */
019public abstract class AbstractGlobalDefinitionNodeItem<D extends IDefinition, I extends INamedInstance>
020    extends AbstractDefinitionNodeItem<D, I> {
021  @NonNull
022  private final IModuleNodeItem metaschemaNodeItem;
023
024  /**
025   * Construct a new Metaschema definition-based node item.
026   *
027   * @param definition
028   *          the Metaschema definition the node item is an instance of
029   * @param metaschemaNodeItem
030   *          the Metaschema module containing this definition
031   */
032  protected AbstractGlobalDefinitionNodeItem(
033      @NonNull D definition,
034      @NonNull IModuleNodeItem metaschemaNodeItem) {
035    super(definition);
036    this.metaschemaNodeItem = metaschemaNodeItem;
037  }
038
039  /**
040   * Get the parent module containing this item.
041   *
042   * @return the module node item
043   */
044  @NonNull
045  protected IModuleNodeItem getModuleNodeItem() {
046    return metaschemaNodeItem;
047  }
048
049  @Override
050  @NonNull
051  public IModuleNodeItem getParentNodeItem() {
052    return getModuleNodeItem();
053  }
054
055  @Override
056  public URI getBaseUri() {
057    return getModuleNodeItem().getDocumentUri();
058  }
059
060  @Override
061  public StaticContext getStaticContext() {
062    return getModuleNodeItem().getStaticContext();
063  }
064
065  @Override
066  public String stringValue() {
067    return "";
068  }
069
070  @Override
071  protected String getValueSignature() {
072    return null;
073  }
074}
